method: simulate possession and ball trajectory, then pose the shipped footballer rig with the renderer's stride-warped locomotion and measure the selected toe against the unmodified simulated ball position after IK

schedulingMatrix.note: This envelope check measures ball-to-player-root control reach. Boot contact is measured separately below.

selectedBootContact.profile: acceleration, deceleration, both turn directions, both feet, lean/heavier body slider extremes, 164/198 cm bodies, 1x/2x/4x/8x
selectedBootContact.limitation: Deterministic rig regression, not a camera-rendered or physical-device observation.
